title: Origin
appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, Live TV, Trakt, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Resume at a glance: The Play button says what it plays and how much is left, with a ring showing how far you got.
Source health: A coloured mark on each stream: smooth, may buffer or slow. Turn it on in Settings > Playback.
Playback info: Press the blue key while a film plays: the source, the file, its bitrate and a live graph of the buffer.
